verdict.rationale: Google Drive offers a documented REST API (v3) with a machine-readable discovery document. It covers programmatic file listing, uploads including resumable ones, bulk modification, permissions management, and push notifications for changes, so scripted automation is possible. However, there is no evidence of an official CLI or of CI or headless auth guidance: authorization is described only in terms of OAuth scopes, and command-line automation relies on the third-party rclone tool cited by the community. Missing for 10: official first-party CLI, documented non-interactive or service-account auth for CI, CI/headless usage guides, independent hands-on corroboration of CI pipelines.
